question: Neena Prasad was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2021 for her contribution to ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniyattam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neena Prasad:-**

 
 
• She was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2021 for her contribution to Mohiniyattam, a classical dance form from Kerala. 
 
• Neena Prasad is a renowned Mohiniyattam dancer and choreographer, who has been actively promoting and preserving the art form for several years.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam:-**
 
 
• **​**It is known for its graceful movements, subtle expressions, and intricate hand gestures.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam**:-

 
 
• It is a classical dance form from Tamil Nadu, characterized by its fast footwork, complex rhythms, and dramatic expressions.
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi**:-
 
 
• It is a classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh, known for its dynamic movements, intricate footwork, and dramatic storytelling.
 
 
 
• **Odissi**:-
 
 
• It is a classical dance form from Odisha, characterized by its fluid movements, curved postures, and intricate hand gestures.
